Ah — the classic. Which swallow do you mean: African or European?

- European swallow (barn swallow, Hirundo rustica): roughly 11 m/s ≈ 40 km/h ≈ 25 mph (typical cruising speed cited by ornithological estimates).
- "African swallow" covers several species with different sizes and speeds, so it’s species-dependent; many small swallows have similar cruising speeds.

Note: "airspeed velocity" means speed through the air (not groundspeed). And yes — "unladen" means not carrying a coconut.
